name: hotspot-meter
title: Hotspot Meter
description: Menu bar network meter with per-app data usage from the last 15 minutes to 4 hours, spike detection and hotspot-only counting.
author: yigit

commands.name: meter
commands.title: Network Usage
commands.description: Shows data usage in the menu bar: totals per window, per-app breakdown, spikes and hotspot diagnosis.

preferences.name: barMode
preferences.title: Menu Bar Title
preferences.description: What the menu bar title shows.

preferences.name: window
preferences.title: Default Window
preferences.description: Time window summed in the menu bar title.

preferences.name: showUpload
preferences.title: Upload
preferences.label: Show upload in the menu bar title
preferences.description: Adds the upload amount next to the download amount.

commands.name: details
commands.title: Network Usage Details
commands.description: Browse data usage by app for the last 15 minutes to 4 hours, with traffic history, destinations and spikes.

preferences.name: countOn
preferences.title: Count Traffic On
preferences.description: Only traffic on these networks is added to windows, spikes and the total. Everything is recorded, so changing this also re-filters the history.

data.title: Selected networks (tick them in the Networks menu)

preferences.name: wifiNames
preferences.title: Wi-Fi Names
preferences.description: Comma-separated Wi-Fi names to count when Count Traffic On is "Selected networks", in addition to the networks you tick. Case-insensitive. The name is read once per network, so it takes a few seconds after you join.

preferences.name: spikeMB
preferences.title: Spike Threshold (MB per Minute)
preferences.description: A minute above this amount, and well above your usual minute, counts as a spike.

preferences.name: capture
preferences.title: Per-App Breakdown
preferences.description: A continuous stream (about 1% of one CPU core) counts every app, including short-lived connections. Without it you only get 10-second snapshots and an optional 30-second capture.

preferences.name: hotspotCapMB
preferences.title: Daily Hotspot Limit (MB)
preferences.description: Optional. The icon turns orange at 50% and red at 90% of this amount used on a hotspot today.
